title: XP and milestones
summary: The DM can award experience points or milestones to the party from Party → Characters, and character sheets show when a character is ready to level up.
items: Give everyone the same XP, or split a total evenly: the preview shows any remainder, and the DM chooses who gets it or keeps it unawarded.
Each award appears once in the party's journal with who got what, and pressing again after a connection error never awards twice.
A sheet shows “Ready to level up” when its XP reaches the next level (SRD 5.2.1 thresholds) or after a milestone. The level only changes when you save it on the sheet.
An imported sheet's Experience points are the starting total.
